sections.text: We design for the heat and the rain first. The rooms follow.

sections.heading: Design services
sections.intro: Five services for houses, shops and workplaces. We design, and the engineers and contractors you appoint build.

sections.heading: A small studio in Bangkok
sections.text: Eaves is named for the overhanging edge of a roof, the part that keeps walls cool and monsoon rain off the windows. It is a reminder to design for the climate we are in.

sections.heading: Tell us about your space
sections.text: Eaves is a fictional studio, but the form works and a real person reads it.

seo.metaTitle: Eaves, a fictional Bangkok design studio
seo.metaDescription: Eaves is a fictional Bangkok architecture and interior design studio, invented for a portfolio demo. Its people, projects and images are not real.
